nom: Perricone MD Neuropeptide The Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: The Neuropeptide Cleansing Balm is my favorite part of my morning and evening skincare routine. It melts into the skin and takes off everything including waterproof mascara in just one application! This saves me so much time and helps me use less products. My skin always feels clean while staying soft and hydrated. I also love that it is formulated with neuropeptides and nourishing ingredients. It leaves my face looking smooth and clean! 10/10!!

This has honestly become my go-to at the end of the day. It melts into the skin so effortlessly and removes everything—makeup, sunscreen, and all the dirt from the day—without any harsh scrubbing. What I love most is how clean my skin feels without ever feeling stripped or dry. The texture is rich but not greasy, and it transforms beautifully as you massage it in. After rinsing, my skin feels soft, smooth, and really nourished, almost like I've already applied skincare. If you're looking for something effective yet gentle that leaves your skin hydrated and glowing, this is hands down the best cleansing balms I've tried.
